claims.statement: Entered as no. 18 in the reconstructed catalogue of Leonardo's books, under Language, Rhetoric and Grammar. Leonardo's wording as rendered there: "the letters of Phalaris".
check_in: Leonardo's autograph book lists: Codex Trivulzianus f. 2r; Codex Atlanticus f. 559r; Madrid Codex II ff. 2v to 3r (which list names this title to be established)
